description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named ChannelAdapter for displaying a list of Channel objects in a RecyclerView, inflating a specific layout for each item and binding channel names to TextViews.

classes.name: ChannelAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying channels in a RecyclerView, managing view creation and data binding.

classes.name: ChannelVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for holding references to the item views and binding channel data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ChannelVH by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the Channel data at the given position to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of channels.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Channel object to the ViewHolder's views by setting the channel name.
